The '''relaxa-bed''' was an Alderaanian [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]] fitted with massage circuits and sleep-inducing harmonics. It enabled a person to experience the equivalent of a full night's rest in a few hours. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had a relaxa-bed in his bedroom in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]].
